scope: The complete standing Church of Saint Francis of Assisi in Ouro Preto, including the pale Rococo frontispiece, cylindrical belfries and the connected nave and chancel tiled roofs.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: IPHAN describes the church’s projecting facade and rounded bells towers, and credits Aleijadinho’s sculptural work.
The municipality identifies the recessed round towers, integrated chancel, and filled ornamental roundel.
